The condition for transitioning from "WaitForInterval" to "CalculateTotalTime" should be when all 5 tablets have been consumed. This can be determined by waiting the total interval time after taking the last tablet. Since each tablet is taken every 15 minutes and there are 4 intervals between 5 tablets, the total wait time would be \(4 \times 15 = 60\) minutes. After this, the total time to consume all tablets (including the initial 0-minute start) would be 60 minutes.

Given that he is supposed to take one tablet every 15 minutes and there are 5 tablets, the total time would be \( (5-1) \times 15 = 60 \) minutes after taking the first tablet. Therefore, "all_tablets_consumed" can be triggered when 60 minutes have passed since the first tablet was taken, indicating that all 5 tablets have been consumed.

The logic for determining when to transition from "WaitForInterval" to "CalculateTotalTime" involves recognizing that after the last tablet is taken, a specific condition is met. 2. WaitForInterval for 15 minutes after taking each subsequent tablet.

- First tablet: 0 minutes
- Second tablet: 15 minutes
- Third tablet: 30 minutes

The transition from "WaitForInterval" to "CalculateTotalTime" should occur after the fifth interval has passed, which is at t=60 minutes. This ensures that all tablets have been consumed.
